title: Small Hermitage
visualBrief: Small Hermitage exterior: distinct north and south green classical pavilions, six riverfront giant-order round columns, paired south columns/pilasters/balconies and central attics, long side galleries, occupied lower rooms beneath a raised hanging-garden deck, faceted green metal roofs and all six native connecting wings with open ground-level arches. Seven exact mapped records only; preserve independent Winter/Old/New Hermitage/Theatre and surrounding streets/water. Geometric roof group is an original simplified silhouette. No furnished museum rooms, copied sculpture/reliefs/lettering, ornamental garden inventory or off-site museum branches.
